Headline: #95 95th and #100 Jeffrey Manor Express Temporary Reroute at 95th/Woodlawn
ShortDescription: 95 95th and 100 Jeffrey Manor Express buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, localized flooding near 95th/Woodlawn.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

#95 95th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via 93rd, Stony Island, 87th, Cottage Grove and 95th, then will resume their normal route.

#100 Jeffrey Manor Express buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via 95th, Stony Island, 87th, Cottage Grove and 95th, then will resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to localized flooding near 95th/Woodlawn.

Headline: #29 State, #36 Broadway, and #62 Archer Temporary Reroute at State/Wacker
ShortDescription: 29 State, 36 Broadway, and 62 Archer buses are temporarily rerouted, due to a street blockage near State/Wacker.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#29 State, #36 Broadway, and #62 Archer buses are temporarily rerouted, due to a street blockage near State/Wacker.

#29 State will reroute as follows:

Northbound buses will operate via State, Wacker, Dearborn, Illinois and over regular route.

Southbound buses will operate via State, Kinzie, Clark, Washington, State and over regular route.

#36 Broadway will reroute as follows:

Southbound: State, Kinzie, Clark and over regular route.

Northbound buses are not affected.

#62 Archer will reroute as follows:

Northbound: Dearborn, Kinzie, Clark and take layover.

Southbound: Clark, Washington, State and over regular route.
